code_excerpts.excerpt: enum class reconciler_state: idle, watching, reconciling, backoff, terminal. struct pending_operation: id, description, generation, completed. struct reconciler_config: base_backoff_ms=1000, max_backoff_ms=30000, backoff_multiplier=2.0, stable_interval_ms=10000, max_restarts=3. class sooperlooper_crash_reconciler: begin_watching(gen), stop_watching(), register_operation(id,desc), complete_operation(id), cancel_all_pending(), check_and_reconcile(supervisor, on_invalidate, on_restart), handle_shutdown_during_startup(supervisor), state(), restart_count(), current_backoff_ms(), backoff_elapsed(now_ms), record_crash_time(now_ms)

check_and_reconcile: polls supervisor, on crash: cancels all pending, invalidates generation via callback, checks restart budget against max_restarts, computes backoff=base*multiplier^(count-1) capped at max_backoff, increments restart_count, returns restarted/backoff/terminal. compute_backoff_ms: pow(base, count-1) capped. handle_shutdown_during_startup: if watching and grace active, calls supervisor.shutdown() and stop_watching()

17 test cases: test_initial_state(4), test_begin_watching(2), test_stop_watching(2), test_register_complete_operation(8), test_cancel_all_pending(2), test_no_crash_when_not_watching(1), test_no_crash_when_alive(2), test_first_crash_immediate_restart(4), test_crash_backoff(4), test_terminal_after_max_restarts(4), test_generation_invalidated(1), test_pending_cancelled_on_crash(2), test_shutdown_during_startup(2), test_shutdown_not_during_startup(1), test_backoff_computation(5), test_backoff_elapsed(3), test_reconciler_state_enum(5). Total: 42 assertions.
